This basket ball game can be played in 3 modes.
* Arcade mode
* Time mode
* Distance mode.

1. Arcade mode
In the basketball arcade mode the player will have 5 balls to shoot. If each of these balls falls into the basket without touching the ring, then the player will earn an extra ball. If the ball misses the basket, then the player will lose a ball score.

2. Time mode
In the Time mode of this basketball game the player needs to shoot, keeping the time in mind. Every time the ball falls into the basket when the player shoots, he gains extra time to shoot the balls.

3. Distance mode
In the distance mode goal is to shoot successfully from the longest possible distance. Initially the player needs to shoot from a distance of 1 meter, if he achieves this goal, then he will have to shoot from a longer distance. If the player misses the basket then the distance is shortened by 1 meter. It is game over when the distance is zero meter.
